_about: Editorial decisions that the automatic folding rule cannot take. Each entry is one judgement over the catalogue strings, with its reason. Titles map a written form to the periodical it is taken to mean; places map a written place form to one city. A place entry may carry 'titles': the alias then applies only to lines with one of these titles. A supplement written into the place, such as 'München (Beilage)', is not an alias: the model keeps it as a periodical of its own.
